hold_reason: Refund mismatch on order 163: the signed batch requested 12727 cents but the refund ledger shows 13902 cents applied (difference 1175 cents). Net balances for this customer would be computed from an unauthorized refund amount. Needs human review before any payouts are recorded.

reply.thought: The handoff shows order 163 with 13902 cents applied but only 12727 requested, a 1175 cent mismatch that could overpay the customer. Before paying anything, I'll check the actual refund ledger.

The ledger shows order 163 refunded at 13902 cents, but the signed batch requested 12727, a 1175 cent discrepancy. Payouts computed from this ledger would reflect a refund Alpha did not authorize, and recorded payouts cannot be recalled, so I'll stop the batch for review.
